description_en: Modifies the name of a node in a PolarDB cluster
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-db-node-description --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000000 --db-node-description NodeDescriptionTest --db-node-id pi-00000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBNodeDescription

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to view information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs.

parameters.description_en:
The name of the node. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

- It must be 2 to 256 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh:
节点名称，需满足如下要求：
- 不能以http://或https://开头。
- 长度为 2~256 个字符。
